definitions.full: H5010. naar [ נָאַר ] verb only Pi`el exact meaning uncertain; probably (from context) abhor, spurn (De compare Arabic abhor , but this is med. ); — Pi`el Perfect subject נִאֵר ׳י, Lam 2:7 (object מִקְדָּשׁוֺ ; || זָנַת ); 2 masculine singular נֵאַרְתָּה Psa 89:40 (object עַבְדְּךָ בְּרית ; || חִלֵּל , and מָאַס זָנַח, 89:39 ; doubts cast on text by Hup (reading נאץ ), Now, Bu Lam 2:7 ).
